result:
Every spring, a small crack appears in the sidewalk outside my window. By summer, something green has found it.

I never know what the plant is called. It has two leaves at first, then several, and for a few weeks it makes that patch of concrete look less certain of itself. People step over it without noticing. Rain collects in the crack and disappears. Somewhere below, roots continue their patient work.

I like that the plant does not need the sidewalk to give way all at once. A little space is enough to begin.
